title: MILLION: MasterIng Long-Context LLM Inference Via Outlier-Immunized KV Product QuaNtization
problem: Long-context LLM inference faces two bottlenecks: (1) quadratic attention complexity causing slowdowns as sequence length increases, and (2) KV cache size scaling linearly with context length; traditional quantization fails due to outliers and on-the-fly de-quantization overhead.
motivation: LLMs supporting 128K-1M token contexts require efficient memory and compute to reduce memory footprint and inference latency, making low-bitwidth KV cache quantization critical for practical deployment.
method: MILLION applies product quantization to KV cache with non-uniform quantization schemes that handle outliers, implements a high-performance GPU kernel with efficient attention computation and asynchronous quantization pipeline, and leverages sparse computation to minimize on-the-fly quantization/de-quantization overhead.
key_novelty: Non-uniform product quantization tailored to KV cache distribution with asynchronous execution pipeline to eliminate on-the-fly quantization bottleneck.
contributions: Analysis of KV cache distribution revealing limitations of uniform quantization
Non-uniform product quantization algorithm for outlier-resistant compression
High-performance GPU inference framework with efficient attention kernel and asynchronous pipeline
4-bit KV quantization achieving 2.09x speedup at 32K context with minimal accuracy loss
limitations: Not discussed; focus is on quantization effectiveness at 32K+ contexts.
primary_theme: Outlier-aware KV cache quantization for long-context LLM inference
